S1.description: Structured data reasoning — Fails to parse/cross-reference structured data from tools.
S1.notes: Common in tasks requiring flight/product comparison, duration computation, price ranking, or cross-order attribute matching.

S2.description: Tool calling precision — Right tool, wrong arguments.
S2.notes: Includes wrong payment IDs, wrong item IDs, case-sensitivity errors in name lookups, and wrong flight numbers. Lowercase name issue appears in R5/R6/R7/R8/R45.

S3.description: Multi-step task completion — Drops sub-tasks or wrong order.
S3.notes: Most common failure category. Especially frequent in tasks with 3+ sub-tasks: cancel+rebook, address+item+payment, return+exchange combos.

S4.description: Precondition verification — Acts without checking conditions.
S4.notes: Primarily airline domain: agent executes cancellations/modifications without verifying insurance, time limits, cabin type, or reason eligibility. Retail: executes refunds without verifying payment method availability.

S5.notes: Includes wrong certificate amounts, wrong refund totals, wrong payment splits, and wrong trip duration comparisons.

S6.description: Record discovery and retrieval — Misses records, wrong record.
S6.notes: Includes failing to find users (wrong name casing, empty fields), retrieving wrong order IDs, missing second relevant records, and failing to discover implied data (NYC address from another order).

S7.description: Information communication — Right action, fails to state values.
S7.notes: Rare: DB matched but agent stated wrong numerical value (tracking number, price, material). Distinct from S5 in that the computation may be correct but wrong value communicated.

S8.description: Conditional and state-aware reasoning — Ignores if-then or wrong API for state.
S8.notes: Second most common. Airline: agent ignores policy state (basic economy cannot be modified, insurance-only cancellation, compensation conditions). Retail: wrong action given order status (pending vs. delivered), ignoring user-stated conditions about refund method or fallback paths.
